contact.heroSubtitle: CPA HCM's team of Auditors and Tax Experts is always ready to answer your questions and build the most optimal advisory plan.
contact.commit1Desc: We get back to you within 15-30 minutes, or by the next business day at the latest.
contact.commit2Desc: Preliminary needs assessment and quote at no extra cost.
contact.commit3Desc: Your business information is protected under the ISO 27001:2022 standard.
contact.faq1A: It's completely free. CPA HCM provides a preliminary consultation and quote right at your first contact, with no hidden fees.
contact.faq2Q: How long after submitting a request will I get a response?
contact.faq2A: Within 15-30 minutes during business hours (Mon - Sat). Requests sent outside business hours will be answered by the start of the next business day at the latest.
contact.faq3Q: Does CPA HCM serve businesses outside Ho Chi Minh City?
contact.faq3A: Yes. Besides our headquarters in Ho Chi Minh City, we have offices in Hanoi, Binh Phuoc, and Dak Nong, and we serve clients nationwide via online consultation.
contact.faq4Q: Is the business information I provide kept confidential?
contact.faq4A: Absolutely. CPA HCM complies with the ISO 27001:2022 information security standard and commits to never sharing client data with any third party.
contact.faq5Q: What documents do I need to prepare before the consultation?
contact.faq5A: None are required. Just provide your contact information and a brief description of your needs — the CPA HCM team will guide you on the specific documents needed after receiving your request.

about.heroDesc: 16 years of independent auditing — over 1,000 enterprises have trusted CPA HCM as their solid financial foundation.
about.sec1Headline: One of 176 audit firms certified by the Ministry of Finance to practice auditing.
about.sec1IssuedBy: Issued by the Department of Planning and Investment of Ho Chi Minh City.
about.sec1Body1: Over 16 years of operation, CPA HCM has become a trusted partner for over 1,000 enterprises — from SMEs to multinational corporations operating in Vietnam.
about.sec1Body2: Our team includes certified public accountants, Masters in Finance & Accounting, MBAs, and IT consultants — fully equipped to deliver high-quality services tailored to client needs.
about.chairmanQuote: Building client trust is our top priority — and that commitment never changes.
about.sec2Body: CPA HCM's Audit Partners, Directors, and Team Leaders are trained in international environments and hold credentials from prestigious organizations such as ACCA, CPA Vietnam, and ICAEW. The average experience per expert exceeds 10 years in auditing and finance.
about.sec3Body: From humble beginnings with a small but passionate team, CPA HCM has continuously expanded, developed, and asserted its position in the Vietnamese auditing industry.
about.visionHeadline: To become Vietnam's #1 trusted financial destination.
about.visionBody: CPA HCM aims to expand into ASEAN, serving as a bridge between Vietnamese businesses and the international market — through audit, accounting, and advisory services meeting international standards.
about.mission1What: Deliver the best solutions, optimizing costs and risks.
about.mission2What: Professional environment, competitive compensation, clear career advancement.
about.mission3What: Uphold professional standards, contributing to a transparent economy.
about.sec5Body: Rather than testing everything, we focus on high-risk areas — optimizing costs and improving the quality of error detection.
about.step1i1: Understand the operating environment and control systems
about.step1i2: Assess business risks and material misstatements
about.step1i3: Prepare a detailed audit program tailored to each client
about.step2i1: Re-evaluate the actual internal control system
about.step2i2: Confirm the approach and scope of the audit
about.step2i3: Perform analytical procedures and collect audit evidence
about.step3i1: Collect feedback from Management, prepare draft report
about.step3i2: Review all evidence and form the audit opinion
about.step3i3: Issue the official Independent Auditor's Report
about.step4i1: Closing meeting with Management, discuss audit findings
about.step4i2: Confirm all client requirements have been met
about.step4i3: Compile audit file per VSA/IFRS standards and archive
about.mottoDesc: Not a slogan. This is a commitment carried out in every audit file, every report page, every client meeting.
about.val1Desc: No pressure — whether from clients or any party — can influence the objectivity of our conclusions.
about.val2Desc: Every file is prepared to VSA/IFRS standards, reviewed at multiple levels before issuance. No exceptions.
about.val3Desc: All client information is protected under ISO 27001:2022 standards. Never shared with any third party.
about.val4Desc: We only sign off on reports when completely confident in their accuracy. If more time is needed to be certain — we will take it.
about.ctaHeadline: Ready to elevate your business finance?
about.tl1desc: Licensed by the Ministry of Finance, becoming 1 of 176 legal audit firms nationwide.
about.tl2desc: Launched Tax Advisory & Accounting services, serving the first 100+ enterprises.
about.tl3desc: Opened Hanoi representative office, surpassing 300+ clients.
about.tl4desc: Launched the Training Center — in-depth CPA and Chief Accountant training.
about.tl5desc: Surpassed 1,000+ enterprises, confirmed position by independent survey.
about.tl6desc: Comprehensive digital transformation — launched online accounting management platform.

about.sec7Body: Every standard we follow is verified by an independent third party — not just a claim on paper.
